dicas.texto: Você está indo bem! O que significa ter 33 partes de 12? Quantos grupos completos de 12 cabem dentro de 33?
Tente dividir 33 por 12. Quantas vezes o 12 cabe no 33 sem passar dele? Esse será seu número inteiro (m1).
Se 12 x 2 = 24, quanto sobra de 33 para chegar em 24? Essa sobra é o seu novo numerador (m2).
Você tem 2 inteiros (24/12). Para chegar em 33/12, falta quanto? O denominador (m3) continua sendo o mesmo da fração original (12).

interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem?" com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); reta numérica de 0 a 3 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 12 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas); texto de apoio na reta: "The number hint is off in this problem!"; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

dicas.texto: Which number tells how many pens are being counted?
Look at the fraction and identify the number above the fraction bar.
The numerator is the first number you read from left to right in the fraction.
Type the number that appears above the fraction bar into the top box.
Which number tells the size of one whole dozen?
Look at the fraction and identify the number below the fraction bar.
The denominator is the second number in the written fraction.
Type the number below the fraction bar into the lower box.
Compare the number of pens with the number needed for one dozen.
A fraction is ... when its numerator is greater than its denominator.
Check whether the top number is larger than the bottom number.
Select the classification that means the fraction represents more than one whole.
How many complete groups of twelve can be made from the total?
Divide the numerator by the denominator; the quotient is the whole part and the remainder is the new numerator.
Use two complete groups of twelve, then determine how many pens remain.
Enter the quotient as the whole part, the remainder as the fractional numerator, and keep the denominator unchanged.
Use the whole-number part first, then move through the fractional part of the next interval.
Start at 2 and divide the distance to 3 into twelve equal intervals.
From 2, count nine of the twelve equal intervals toward 3.
Place the point three intervals before 3, at the location represented by 2 plus nine twelfths.
What should you verify before submitting the number-line task?
Review the fraction fields, the mixed-number representation, and the point on the line.
Make sure the point is between 2 and 3 and matches the converted mixed number.
Confirm that every required field is complete, then press the Done button once.

nodes.description: Inversão por viés de que o denominador é sempre o maior número.
nodes.instruction: The numerator is the top number, not the larger or smaller number chosen by size. In this fraction, the top number represents the total pens.

nodes.description: Aluno marca apenas a parte fracionária, ignorando o inteiro (2) na reta numérica.
nodes.instruction: The fraction represents two whole dozens plus nine twelfths. Do not place only the fractional part; include the whole-number part.

nodes.description: Erro de contagem: contar as linhas em vez dos espaços entre elas.
nodes.instruction: Count the spaces between the marks, not the marks themselves. The fractional part uses nine equal intervals.

nodes.description: O aluno foca no que falta para completar a próxima unidade (3/12) em vez da fração (9/12).
nodes.instruction: That location shows how much is left before the next whole number. The point should show the amount already represented after 2.
